questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Aparna said she was sorry she had _______ to bring the book I had asked for.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **forgotten**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 The correct option is **'Forgotten'.**
 
 
• 
 The formula for the past perfect tense is had + [past participle].

 
 
• 
 ​For example,* I turned back to the house and saw that someone named Tootles **had defaced my front door!*
 
 
 
 
• 
 The past perfect tense is for talking about something that happened before something else.
 
 
• 
 From the above understanding, it is clear that all the other options are wrong.
 
 
• 
 The correct sentence is *' Aparna said she was sorry she had **forgotten** to bring the book I had asked for.'*
 
 
• 
 The correct option is **2**.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• सही विकल्प** 'भूल गया' (Forgotten)** है।
 
• 
 पास्ट परफेक्ट टेंस का फॉर्मूला** है + [पिछले पार्टिकलर]**। (Had + past participle)

 
 
• 
 उदाहरण के लिए, * I turned back to the house and saw that someone named Tootles **had defaced my front door!*
 
 
 
 
• 
 भूतकाल का सही काल किसी और चीज के बारे में बात करने के लिए है जो किसी और चीज से पहले हुआ था।
 
 
• 
 उपरोक्त समझ से यह स्पष्ट है कि अन्य सभी विकल्प गलत हैं।
 
 
• 
 सही वाक्य है *' Aparna said she was sorry she had forgotten to bring the book I had asked for.'*
 
 
• 
 सही विकल्प **2 (Option 2)** है।

questions.question:

The club __are organizing__ a two-day yoga and meditation camp for beginners.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'is organizing.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 The error is **'are organizing.' **

 
 
• 
 Instead of '**Are**', '**Is**' should be used.
 
 
 
 
• 
 According to the rules of **Subject-verb Agreement**, If the subject is singular, the verb must be singular too. (विषय-क्रिया समझौते के नियमों के अनुसार, यदि विषय एकवचन है, तो क्रिया भी एकवचन होनी चाहिए।)

 
 
• 
 Therefore, 'The club' is a **noun phrase** that is singular. Therefore, 'Is' should be used.
 
 
 
 
• 
 The correct sentence is, *The club is organizing__ a two-day yoga and meditation camp for beginners.*
 
 
• 
 Hence, the correct option is **1**.
